patterns.note: Alternating background colors (white, light grey, purple, light green, dark grey) are used to clearly delineate major content sections, providing visual rhythm down the page.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are consistently used for section titles, often paired with a lighter weight, slightly smaller sub-heading to introduce content.

A vibrant light green is used exclusively for primary call-to-action buttons and key accent elements, creating strong visual emphasis against a predominantly neutral palette of dark grey, white, and light greys.

The header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, while the hero section features a dynamic background with a subtle grid pattern and floating social media icons that parallax, moving independently from the foreground content to create depth.
Dedicated social proof sections are integrated, showcasing both company logos and user testimonials with avatars, reinforcing trust and community.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that maintains its position at the top of the screen as the user scrolls. The hero section utilizes a sophisticated background animation, likely powered by canvas or WebGL (as indicated by `canvas, webgl-three`), where a subtle grid pattern and various social media icons float and parallax, creating a dynamic sense of depth and visual interest as the page scrolls. Content sections below the hero appear as the user scrolls, without explicit fade-in or slide-up animations for the main content blocks, relying on clear visual separation through background colors and spacing.

design_tokens.type_scale: The type scale features an oversized, bold sans-serif hero heading (~4-5x body text) with clear, readable body text and smaller, uppercase labels for sub-sections, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — buttons, cards, and input fields feature slightly rounded corners, avoiding sharp edges or full pills.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — sections are well-padded vertically, and content within components is evenly spaced, creating a clean and organized feel without being overly dense or airy.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the subtle yet sophisticated animated background in the hero section. It uses a grid pattern and floating social media icons with a parallax effect, likely powered by WebGL, which adds a modern, dynamic, and engaging feel without distracting from the primary message. This elevates the site beyond a typical static marketing page.
